title: Nidhögg the Thundering

# Nidhögg the Thundering

Internal ID: SwordNiedhoggLightning | Type: Sword | Source: Black forge | Usage: Weapon | Wielding: One-handed | Crafting Materials: Flametal x18, Iolite x3 | Attack speed: 1.84 s | Chain last hit: 2x damage, +20% knockback | Hitbox: 2.7 range, 10 angle, 1.0 height, 0.7 ray | Movement speed: -5%

# Introduction

Nidhögg the Thundering is the upgraded form of Nidhögg using the Iolite. Like all upgraded-weapons that use Iolite, they gain 10 lightning damage and their hit effect has a 25% chance to apply Chain Lightning.
An upgraded Nidhögg will NOT keep its upgrade level when it is modified using gemstones.
Like all other one-handed swords it has:
• Primary attack is a 3-hit combo with double damage on the last hit. No damage penalty against multiple targets.
• Secondary attack deals 3x damage with a slightly longer reach.

## Upgrade information

Total cost for the fully upgraded sword is 1 Nidhögg, 42 Flametal and 6 Iolites. However, it is only 6 Flametal and 1 Iolite for level 2, which is the highest upgrade currently obtainable as of patch 218.15.
